12 days · Private journey · From $2,480

The Island in Slow Motion

Colombo → Tea Country → South Coast. A considered journey balancing cultural depth, open landscapes and enough unscripted time to make it yours.

The journey
A route with direction,
never a rigid schedule.

Every stay, transfer and encounter is handled. The rhythm remains spacious, and every detail can be changed around your interests.

How the story unfolds.

Days 1–3

Begin in the old kingdoms

Arrive gently, settle into the island and follow ancient paths through forest and stone.

Days 4–7

Move with the hills

Take the slow train into tea country, walk the estates and dine by the fire as mist gathers.

Days 8–10

Follow the road south

Trade mountain air for the coast, stopping at makers, markets and a secluded stay by the sea.

Days 11–12

End without hurrying

Leave the final days open for saltwater, long lunches and one last Sri Lankan sunset.

Included
Private by design.
Supported throughout.

Handpicked accommodation, daily breakfast, private transport, specialist hosts, selected experiences and 24/7 local assistance are included. International flights and travel insurance are excluded.
